name: read_text
description: DEPRECATED: Use `read_object` instead. Reads non-binary text content from an object.

generation.description: Optional. The generation of the object to read. If omitted or set to 0, the latest generation is read.

readLimit.description: Optional. The maximum number of bytes to read. If not specified, the read starts from the beginning of the object and continues until the end of the object. Zero means no limit. Negative values are not allowed.

readOffset.description: Optional. The offset from the beginning of the object at which the data should be read. If not specified, the read starts from the beginning of the object. Negative values are allowed and are interpreted as an offset from the end of the object.
